chains.rationale: The reused claim represented the reminder as one day even though the resulting form visibly read “1 minute before.” At the reuse target, the agent accepted that false completion and saved the event; the following step terminated without any correction. Because the reminder defect already existed when reused, the target preserved it rather than creating it.

summary: Both strict-MHR chains preserve the same visible false-completion defect: a one-minute reminder is treated as the required one-day reminder, followed by saving and termination without correction. Independent prefix defects concern the unrelated lecture topic and unchanged end time.
